rows.grounds: first member of compound naming disease

items.question: Which specific winds and disease does this practice claim to eliminate?
premises: Both eliminative effects are attributed to the same practice.
items.inference: Therefore, the practice is claimed to remove eighty winds and the disease of leprosy.
uncertainties: Whether vātān refers to bodily winds or wind-related disorders is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: It destroys the eighty winds, and indeed it destroys the disease of leprosy.
